name: Yile Yara Vianello
bio: Yile Yara Vianello (born February 2, 1999) is an Italian actress. Vianello was born in Brazil but grew up in Valle degli Elfi, near Pistoia. The actress began her career at age 13 in Alice Rohrwacher’s film “Corpo Celeste” (2011).
